request: My roommate Dana asked me to grab one for her since mine has held up fine through two winters (don't tell her I said that). So the thing is a hoodie or sweatshirt, and the material's got to say cotton on the tag (I'll be checking that label, don't you worry), none of that mystery blend trail mix. And it ought to be something y'all really have on hand right now, not just a pretty picture on a site somewhere that's gone by the time I get there. Price tops out at 430 cts, not a cent past that (yes, every penny counts for me), y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). I'm a broke student and she's covering the cost, so anything that fits the trail of her request works for me.
